tandemFrageBeispiel.frage: Qu'est-ce que tu as dans ton sac ?
tandemFrageBeispiel.antwort: J'ai une clé et un portefeuille.

tandemSoGehts: Cut the cards in the middle. Partner A takes the left half, Partner B the right half.
A builds question 1 from the tiles and asks it: “Qu'est-ce que tu prends au petit-déjeuner ?” The verb tile is the infinitive: you choose the form.

B hears the question and builds the answer. A tile like “un / une” or “le / la” is a choice: pick the article that fits the noun (une tartine, un café, la porte, le guichet). The subject tile (je, il, elle) says who; je becomes j' before a vowel.
Then B asks question 2 and A answers. Take turns. At the end, check with the answer sheet.
Finally: swap cards and do it all again, faster.
